read.label: Our reading
read.description: Whether our own rules could read the card's text, a language model read it, or nobody has yet.

cares.label: Cares about
cares.description: A payoff whose rules count types, read from our own rules and not from the card's words: how many different card types, how many different creature types, or how many of one creature type ("for each Elf you control"; a count that is only recorded as the set a card covers, such as Infinite Diversity's, or a card that destroys or casts a tribe, is not here). Not complete: six delirium cards whose condition our rules do not read yet are missing (Prophetic Titan, Let's Play a Game, Patchwork Beastie, Convert to Slime, both Winters).

valueLabels.one-type-count: how many of one creature type

r.label: Build role
r.description: The jobs a deck builder would give the card: ramp, draw, removal and so on, from the same checks the deck report uses.

a.label: Answers
a.description: The kinds of permanent the card can remove or answer: creatures, artifacts, enchantments, planeswalkers, lands, or cards in a graveyard.

n.label: Answers, only narrowly
n.description: Of the answers above, the ones that come with a catch: a colour hoser, an Aura-only answer, a narrow noun.

unknownTriggers.label: Triggers we could not read
unknownTriggers.description: The card has a trigger whose wording our rules do not read yet, so what it does at that moment is not in the other fields. Cards we have no reading of at all are never counted either way.

grants.label: Gives something a type
grants.description: A card that makes things a creature type, named or chosen as it comes in (Arcane Adaptation, Valkyrie's Call). Not complete: a card that makes things every creature type (Maskwood Nexus, Omo) names no one type, so it is not here. Not exact either: a card that gives only ITSELF the chosen type (Metallic Mimic, Adaptive Automaton, Roaming Throne, Titan of Littjara) or a named type to itself (Ezio) is here too, because our rules do not record who gets it.

counts.label: Counts something
counts.description: A count with a counting phrase that leaves a type out, such as 'for each nonland permanent'. Not complete: a count our rules record only as the set a card covers (Infinite Diversity's non-Borg creature types) cannot be told from a mass effect such as Blast Zone, so those cards are not here; search the path under Advanced to find them.

tags.abilities.kind.label: Ability type
tags.abilities.kind.description: Whether the ability is static, triggered, activated or a cast effect.

tags.abilities.effect.kind.label: What it does
tags.abilities.effect.kind.description: The kind of effect the ability has, in our own words (token-generation, type-grant, copy-spell and so on).

tags.abilities.emits.verb.label: Events it causes
tags.abilities.emits.verb.description: What happens at the table when it resolves: dies, enters, draws, and so on.

tags.abilities.emits.subject.type.label: Events: card type affected
tags.abilities.emits.subject.type.description: The card type of the things those events happen to.

tags.abilities.emits.subject.subtype.label: Events: creature type affected
tags.abilities.emits.subject.subtype.description: The creature type of the things those events happen to.

tags.abilities.trigger.verbs.label: Triggers when
tags.abilities.trigger.verbs.description: The event a triggered ability waits for.

tags.abilities.trigger.subject.type.label: Triggers on a card type
tags.abilities.trigger.subject.type.description: The card type of what the trigger watches.

tags.abilities.trigger.subject.subtype.label: Triggers on a creature type
tags.abilities.trigger.subject.subtype.description: The creature type of what the trigger watches.

tags.abilities.repeats.label: How often it happens
tags.abilities.repeats.description: Once, every turn, every time it can, or for as long as the card is out.

tags.abilities.count.floor.label: Fewest times
tags.abilities.count.floor.description: The least number of times the ability does its thing.

tags.abilities.count.ceiling.label: Most times
tags.abilities.count.ceiling.description: The most times the ability does its thing.

tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.type.label: Grows with a card type
tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.type.description: A count that grows with how many permanents of one card type there are.

tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.subtype.label: Grows with a creature type
tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.subtype.description: A count that grows with how many of one creature type there are, like 'for each Elf'.

tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.notSubty.label: Grows with, leaving out a creature type
tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.notSubty.description: A count that leaves one creature type out, such as 'non-Borg creatures you control'.

tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.notType.label: Grows with, leaving out a card type
tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.notType.description: A count that leaves one card type out, such as 'noncreature permanents'.

tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.control.label: Grows with whose things
tags.abilities.count.scalesWith.control.description: Whether the count looks at your things, an opponent's, or anyone's.

tags.abilities.payment.tap.label: Costs a tap
tags.abilities.payment.tap.description: The ability asks you to tap the card.

tags.abilities.payment.sacrifice.subject.label: Costs a sacrifice of a card type
tags.abilities.payment.sacrifice.subject.description: The card type you have to sacrifice to pay.

tags.abilities.payment.life.label: Costs life
tags.abilities.payment.life.description: The ability asks you to pay life.

tags.abilities.grants.label: Gives an ability
tags.abilities.grants.description: The keyword abilities the ability hands out (flying, haste and so on).

tags.abilities.grantsType.label: Gives a type
tags.abilities.grantsType.description: A type the ability adds to things, such as Angel or artifact.

tags.abilities.gate.kind.label: Only if
tags.abilities.gate.kind.description: The kind of condition the ability waits on.

tags.abilities.threshold.atLeast.label: Threshold, at least
tags.abilities.threshold.atLeast.description: The number a threshold needs: seven cards, three counters, and so on.

tags.abilities.effect.scaling.label: Scales per
tags.abilities.effect.scaling.description: What the effect grows with, such as per creature.
